modules.module_title: Review vessel documents prior to berthing

pcs.pc_description: receive documents from the vessel prior to its arrival at port
check if the vessel information is correct and verify as per manifest
check the bill of lading against manifest for cargo
endorse the request for docking of the vessel

modules.module_title: Review export related documentation for cargo

pcs.pc_description: receive let-out export documents from the shipper or freight forwarder
review shipping bill for classification of items and check for mandatory clearances from customs and Participative Government Agencies (PGAs) etc.
coordinate with backend officials of consolidators, shippers and freight forwarders to resolve queries regarding cargo documentation
endorse the bill of lading post verification for unloading and stuffing of cargo and loading of containers/ cargo onto the vessel

modules.module_title: Review import related documentation for cargo

pcs.pc_description: receive shipping manifest and the bill of entry from the shipper or freight forwarder and check that necessary approvals related to customs and other PGAs are taken prior to import
check that the cargo and containers match as per the manifest and the bill of entry
coordinate with backend officials of consolidators, shippers and freight forwarders to resolve queries regarding cargo documentation
endorse the shipping manifest post verification for unloading and de- stuffing of cargo

modules.module_title: Check the suitability of the vessel to carry cargo

pcs.pc_description: check if the vessel is equipped to carry the required cargo
inspect the hatch prior to loading and unloading for any damages and check if the alternate unused valves are sealed
check if the tank/hold for breakage, fractures, corrosion, coating, hull damage, etc.
check if the cargo pumps, stripping equipment, conveyor and loading/unloading equipment are fully operational with emergency controls
check that all closing appliances such as gaskets, high level alarms, vapour locks, air locks are calibrated and operational

modules.module_title: Perform draught measurement and valuation

pcs.pc_description: verify that the vessel is upright in still and calm waters with minimum trim, and correct computation based on tidal conditions, currents, etc.
check the ballast tanks and take measurement of weight and density of water present
factor in adjustments regarding existing cargo weight and residual weight of the vessel due to ballast water, oils, etc.
measure the vessels forward, aft, mid-ship, port-side and starboard draughts
take measurements at the start and close of loading/ unloading of each tank/ hold
calculate deductibles, mean of all observed draughts, mean of means draught, and estimate the trim corrections
calculate the value of water displacement based on true mean draught applying density correction
estimate the weight of cargo on board deducting weight of ship and other deductibles

modules.module_title: Certify that the cargo is safe and secured

pcs.pc_description: certify the weight, volume and value of cargo loaded in the vessel
certify that the cargo is uniformly loaded and is safe and secure for carriage
certify that the cargo is suitably labelled

modules.module_title: Survey container and cargo for exports

pcs.pc_description: inspect the container to be stuffed and provide a inspection before report with photos of empty container
review bill of lading for classification of items and check that markings, labels and numbers for packages is in line with the container and geography to be shipped and highlight discrepancies
check for damages on the packages and highlight the same to authorities, shipper or freight forwarder
check that right cargo is stuffed as per the stuffing plan, its securely lashed and provide a safe and secured certification
conduct a physical count during stuffing, certify and highlight discrepancies
provide container loading report with photos of before, during and after stuffing and verify the stuffing as per plan

modules.module_title: Survey container and cargo for imports

pcs.pc_description: inspect the container for damages before de- stuffing, and report the same
open the container and verify the content with respect to the manifest on both quantity and type of packages
check for damages after de-stuffing of cargo
cross check the packages with respect to labels, markings and identification numbers with the shipping manifest and provide certification on number count highlighting discrepancies and damages
provide a survey report and certification stating the overall count and damages, if any

modules.module_title: Survey hazardous cargo

pcs.pc_description: ensure hazardous goods are identified from documentation provided, including class labels, manifests, Safety Data Sheets (SDS)/Material Safety Data Sheets (MSDS) and other documentation
check that the hazardous cargo containers are appropriately labelled on all sides
check that the hazardous cargo is kept near the exit gates and are properly segregated
check that the hazardous cargo packages are adequately lashed
check that all precautions are taken while stuffing and de-stuffing
inspect if hazardous cargo is stored with necessary precautions as per the SOP and International Maritime Dangerous Goods (IMDG) guidelines
certify the hazardous cargo in the container loading plan report as well as the de-stuffing report

modules.module_title: Survey during loading and unloading onto vessel

pcs.pc_description: receive information regarding the number of containers to be loaded / unloaded
take photographs of vessel prior to loading/ unloading and post operations
check that all containers are appropriately labelled
check that the right containers are loaded and unloaded by verifying the labels and marking
check that all loaded containers are appropriately lashed and are safe and secured
perform count and provide valuation of cargo for all containers which are loaded/ unloaded and make remark in survey report

modules.module_title: Inspect liquid tank and loading/unloading equipment

pcs.pc_description: check the tank for breakage or fractures, corrosion and missing coating and ensure that the tank is clean prior to loading
inspect the hatch prior to loading and unloading for any damages and alternate unused valves are sealed
inspect if the cargo pumps and stripping arrangements are fully operational with emergency controls
check if the pipework and hoses have leakages, corrosion, damages
ensure that operational area is clean, and all emergency controls and systems are functional
check that all closing appliances gaskets, devices, high level alarms, vapour locks, air locks are calibrated and operational
take photographs and provide remarks in the survey report

modules.module_title: Take draught and flow measurements during loading/unloading

pcs.pc_description: verify that the pipeline is clean and deformation free for operations after pigging process
take measurements of liquid in the bulk tank and cross verify with the vessel measurements factoring in usual transmission losses
measure the flow and pressure at different points in the pipeline to check for leakage and reduction in flow
check measurement of volume of cargo transported via pipeline from the tank farm to the vessel and vice versa
take draught measurements at the beginning, during and after loading/unloading of liquid cargo as per SOP

modules.module_title: Supervise closing operations

pcs.pc_description: check that the pumps and pipework are removed, and the valves are closed
ensure that the tank is sealed post loading of cargo and verify that all alternate valves are sealed and there is no leakage
certify that the tank is sealed and in good shape to carry the cargo
certify that emergency controls for handling of the hazardous cargo is in place

modules.module_title: Value cargo and certify

pcs.pc_description: calculate the weight of cargo loaded/unloaded based on draught measurements taken
compute volume of liquid loading/unloaded factoring in usual transmission losses
check the computation with the input documentation and certify quantity loaded/unloaded
compute and submit the valuation report

modules.module_title: Inspect dry bulk storage hold and loading/unloading equipment

pcs.pc_description: inspect the hold prior to loading, for any damages and for suitability for carriage with respect to fractures, corrosion and missing coating, vacuum locks, etc.
check that hold covers, hold coaming, operating systems and safety devices are in good operational condition
ensure that all emergency controls and systems are functional
inspect that all closing appliances temperature controls, gaskets, devices, high level alarms, vapour locks, air locks are calibrated and operational
check that the conveyor system is cargo free prior to start of loading/ unloading operations
confirm that the storage is clean prior to taking reading in case of loading
inspect the moisture content in the dry cargo and take note of it
check the conveyor system for functionality of emergency controls and damages

modules.module_title: Take draught and cargo loading/unloading measurement

pcs.pc_description: check that the wagons/ trucks are clean and take measurement pre and post loading operations
take draught measurements at the beginning, during and after loading/unloading of dry bulk cargo as per SOP

modules.module_title: Supervise closing operations

pcs.pc_description: check that the hold is uniformly filled and with respect to balancing of the ship
check that the cargo is safe and secured for all weather conditions
check that the hold coaming is secured, and the hold is water tight
certify that emergency controls for handling of the hazardous cargo is in place

modules.module_title: Value cargo and certify

pcs.pc_description: calculate the weight of cargo loaded based on draught measurements taken
compute the weight of cargo loaded and transported factoring in usual transmission losses
certify the cargo loaded and unloaded based on the computations

modules.module_title: Verify and approve import documentation

pcs.pc_description: check the importer documentation for compliance to regulatory requirements

check import consignment documentation including invoice, packing list, type of cargo (liquid, hazardous chemicals, perishables etc.), shipping bill/ Airway bill, Bill of lading, the quantity, value, packing, labelling, weight, size of the cargo, delivery order, certificate of origin, industrial license, insurance document, certificate of origin, letter of credit, bond etc. for completeness
check invoice for accuracy of number of packages, quantity, unit rate, total Freight on Board (FOB) / (Cost Insurance and Freight) CIF value, etc.
check the manifest for details of the cargo imported, quantity, details of discharge port-wise, etc. and ensure the duties are duly paid
verify documentation for special cases such as pilferage, damage of goods, etc. as required
confirm final clearance in the form of a LEO (Let Export Order)/ Out of Customs charge (OCC)

modules.module_title: Verify and approve export documentation

pcs.pc_description: inspect exporter documentation for compliance to regulatory requirement

check export consignment documentation including destination country, shipment date, type of cargo, quantity, value, packing, labelling, weight, size of the cargo and nature of cargo (liquid, hazardous chemicals, perishables etc.) insurance details, etc.
verify documents required for clearance such as contract, letter of credit, Invoice, packing list, Shipping declaration, Purchase order, Statutory Declaration Form (SDF) declaration
check for documentation compliance to custom regulation for dangerous goods, valuable items, etc.
check for bonds to be executed with the customs official for duty exempted items

modules.module_title: Liaise with the officials to pass the assessment of shipment

pcs.pc_description: submit all documents required for custom clearance to custom officials as per their satisfaction
respond to any queries raised by the custom officials
make note of any objection raised by custom officials on the cargo
escalate objections and remarks of custom officials to the supervisor and the customer as required

modules.module_title: Ensure compliance with legal and regulatory framework

pcs.pc_description: check for correctness of documentation uploaded into Indian Customs Electronic Commerce/ Electronic Data Gateway (ICEGATE) web portal and submission of required documents to shipping lines, Directorate General of Foreign Trade (DGFT), Participative Government Agencies (PGAs) etc.
monitor compliance to organisational policies and procedures, local, country and international laws on a regular basis
identify areas of non-compliance, examine reasons and make recommendations for corrections to ensure compliance
ensure compliance to documentation related to hazardous goods complying with International Maritime Dangerous Goods (IMDG) and Hazardous Chemicals (HAZCHEM) requirements
maintain records for clearance activities and shipment for the mandated duration as specified by regulations
ensure all documentation is uploaded in the portal
